sisi.depan: At the far end of the narrow lane stands a wide, intricately carved teakwood gateway with glowing gold-inlaid patterns, from which hangs a single, bright plasma lantern.
sisi.kanan: A long wooden counter holds rows of illuminated glass jars filled with exotic spices, beside a display of stacked folded cloths with shifting holographic batik motifs.
sisi.belakang: Behind the viewpoint, a low, moss-covered stone wall marks the lane's entrance, next to a small kiosk with a self-purifying clay water dispenser.
sisi.kiri: A corner stall features steaming glass vessels of herbal drinks connected by copper pipes, next to another stall displaying woven synthetic-fiber baskets under the exposed support beams of a taller building.

tengah: A low-hovering cargo pallet loaded with covered ceramic containers sits in the center of the lane, facing forward.
atas: A dense network of weathered fabric tarps is stretched overhead, interspersed with flickering energy-field patches and dangling plasma-oil lamps in ornate brass casings.
